jobs.title: Lead Program Manager
jobs.description:
Alternate Locations: Radnor, PA (Pennsylvania); Charlotte, NC (North Carolina); Fort Wayne, IN (Indiana); Greensboro, NC (North Carolina)

Work Arrangement:

Hybrid : Employee will work 3 days a week in a Lincoln office

Relocation assistance:   is not available for this opportunity.

Requisition #:  76366

The Role at a Glance

As part of the AI PMO team, this position serves as the Program Manager is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional programs that deliver enterprise data platforms, data products, artificial intelligence and machine learning capabilities, and the engineering foundations required to operate them securely, reliably, and at scale.

The role translates strategic priorities and technical roadmaps into executable plans; coordinates delivery across the AI, Data and Analytics team (AIDA) ; and establishes the governance, transparency, and delivery discipline needed to manage scope, dependencies, resources, risks, and measurable outcomes from discovery through production adoption. Hands-on proficiency with Jira is essential.

What you'll be doing

Program Leadership

- Leads the end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of complex AI, data, and engineering programs, including data platforms, analytics products, AI/ML solutions, APIs, integrations, and cloud modernization initiatives.

- Partners with engineering leaders, architects, product managers, data scientists, and business stakeholders to define program scope, priorities, success measures, and delivery approaches.

- Translates product, architecture, and technology roadmaps into integrated program plans with clear milestones, dependencies, resource needs, and release targets.

- Facilitates program operating rhythms, including planning sessions, dependency reviews, risk discussions, release readiness assessments, and executive updates.

Technical Program Management

- Develops sufficient technical understanding to participate credibly in architecture and engineering discussions, identify risks, surface delivery gaps, and communicate tradeoffs.

- Identifies, analyzes, and drives resolution of program risks, issues, and dependencies, including data quality, environment readiness, infrastructure, security, governance, and competing engineering priorities.

- Coordinates delivery activities across software development, cybersecurity, architecture, privacy, data governance, AI governance, change management, and release management functions.

- Drives release and production readiness across teams, including testing, deployment planning, adoption activities, support readiness, and post-implementation reviews.

Jira, Delivery Excellence & Communication

- Uses Jira as the primary system of record for program execution, maintaining visibility into work, dependencies, releases, delivery progress, and program health.

- Establishes delivery standards for backlog management, estimation, ownership, status reporting, dependency tracking, and release planning.

- Produces clear communications and reporting for technical teams and senior leaders, including status updates, dashboards, roadmaps, risk summaries, and recommendations.

- Improves program delivery practices by standardizing workflows, reporting, governance routines, and tools that increase transparency, quality, and execution speed.

What we’re looking for

Must Haves

- 4 Year/Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience (4 years of experience in lieu of Bachelor's)

- 5 – 7+ Years experience in Project/Program Management that directly aligns with the specific responsibilities for this position

- Strong understanding of software development, engineering delivery, data platforms, analytics solutions, cloud technologies, or AI/ML implementations.

- Experience using Jira for planning, execution, dependency management, and reporting.

- Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and drive alignment across technical and business teams.

- Strong communication, facilitation, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills

Application Deadline

Applications for this position will be accepted through 11/30/26 subject to earlier closure due to applicant volume.

The Role at a Glance

The Analyst on the Funds Strategy Team is a key contributor supporting fund strategy, analytics, project management, and business reporting across Lincoln’s manager-of-managers investment platform. The role combines investment analysis, fund lineup oversight, cross-functional project coordination, stakeholder management, and executive-level communication. The analyst will help maintain and evaluate fund lineups supporting Lincoln’s insurance and retirement products, conduct quantitative analysis using internal and external data sources, and develop reports and presentations that communicate strategic recommendations to senior leadership, board stakeholders, and business partners. The position supports assets across equity, fixed income, multi-asset funds, and Lincoln’s proprietary variable insurance trust mutual funds.

What you'll be doing

- Support and coordinate cross-functional projects from planning through execution, managing timelines, deliverables, dependencies, and stakeholder communications.

- Maintain, monitor, and analyze fund lineups for insurance and retirement products, including performance, fees, risk metrics, product guideline compliance, and fund change activity.

- Perform quantitative analysis using large and complex datasets and identify meaningful trends and insights.

- Develop executive-ready reports, presentations, dashboards, and recommendations for leadership and business stakeholders.

- Build and maintain relationships across investment partners, internal business teams, and key stakeholders while navigating competing priorities.

- Utilize analytical tools and data sources such as Morningstar, Dataiku, and other investment research platforms.

- Identify opportunities to improve processes, reporting efficiency, data quality, and workflow automation, including the application of AI tools where appropriate.

- Remain current on industry trends, regulatory developments, and market changes that may impact investment offerings and insurance products.

What we’re looking for

Must haves:

- Proven Project Management Ability: Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent projects, coordinating cross-functional stakeholders, tracking milestones, and driving initiatives to completion in a deadline-driven environment.

- Fund and Investment Analysis Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities with experience evaluating investment products, fund performance, expense structures, and related investment data. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets are required. Ability to understand which data points are most meaningful when analyzing mutual funds or investment strategies.

- Strong Written and Verbal Communication: Ability to translate complex investment and data-driven concepts into concise, polished communications, reports, and presentations. Proven relationship management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to influence, persuade, and manage competing stakeholder priorities.

- Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.

- 3-5 years experience in investments, mutual funds, fund research, analytics, or related financial services disciplines.

- Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and other Microsoft Office applications.

- Demonstrated track record of strong performance, initiative, problem solving, and continuous improvement.

Nice to haves:

- Insurance or Asset Management Industry Experience: Familiarity with variable annuity, variable life, retirement, or other insurance-linked investment products, including awareness of industry and regulatory considerations.

- Advanced Data, Automation, and Presentation Tools: Experience using Excel VBA/macros, AI tools such as Claude, Dataiku, or similar technologies to improve analytics, reporting, and operational efficiency.

- Experience with Investment Data Vendors: Knowledge of Morningstar and other investment data providers, with the ability to validate and reconcile information across vendor platforms, SEC filings, and internal sources.

This role will lead and advance the strategic AI agenda for the Information Technology (IT) organization, aligning enterprise priorities, technology capabilities, and business outcomes in partnership with IT senior leadership and the AI & Data Analytics (AIDA) organization. The position also contributes to annual budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, and ad hoc analyses that support business growth and profitability.

- Partner with business leaders to provide financial guidance and decision support related to operational initiatives, strategic investments, and resource planning.

- Develop financial models and analyses to evaluate business opportunities, including new products, pricing strategies, sales growth initiatives, and workforce planning scenarios.

- Collect, compile, and evaluate financial information to develop and deliver both standard and ad hoc financial analyses.

- Assist in the preparation and maintenance of financial forecasts, management reporting, and executive presentations.

- Support monthly and quarterly close activities, including reconciliations and financial performance reviews.

- Communicate financial insights, trends, and emerging issues to management and recommend actions where appropriate.

- Collaborate with team members and cross-functional partners to improve financial processes, reporting capabilities, and decision-making tools.
